name: StarCraft: Enslavers
summary: A bonus single-player campaign for StarCraft, set shortly after the fall of the Terran Confederacy. The player commands a Terran Dominion task force sent to hunt down the pirate Alan Schezar, who has used plundered protoss technology to enslave a zerg cerebrate and turn its brood to his own ends. A branching mid-campaign choice decides whether the player rescues Schezar's protoss captives or destroys the enslaved cerebrate outright.
